name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 8.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 8, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 8, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 8, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on automating large systems in action
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on automating large systems in action

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence systems, on everyday life, including skilled trades
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence systems, on everyday life, including skilled trades

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 8, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess developments in cell biology and their impact on individuals, society, and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess developments in cell biology and their impact on individuals, society, and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess how various technologies have enhanced our understanding of cells and cellular processes
specific_expectations.text_html: assess how various technologies have enhanced our understanding of cells and cellular processes

specific_expectations.text: analyse beneficial and harmful effects of developments in cell biology and associated emerging technologies on human health and the environment, while taking different perspectives into consideration
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse beneficial and harmful effects of developments in cell biology and associated emerging technologies on human health and the environment, while taking different perspectives into consideration

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the basic structure and function of plant and animal cells and cell processes
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the basic structure and function of plant and animal cells and cell processes

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of cells, using cell theory
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of cells, using cell theory

specific_expectations.text: identify organelles and other cell components, including the nucleus, cell membrane, cell wall, chloroplasts, vacuole, mitochondria, and cytoplasm, and explain their basic functions
specific_expectations.text_html: identify organelles and other cell components, including the nucleus, cell membrane, cell wall, chloroplasts, vacuole, mitochondria, and cytoplasm, and explain their basic functions

specific_expectations.text: compare the structure and function of plant and animal cells
specific_expectations.text_html: compare the structure and function of plant and animal cells

specific_expectations.text: explain the processes of diffusion and osmosis within a cell
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the processes of diffusion and osmosis within a cell

specific_expectations.text: describe various unicellular and multicellular organisms, and compare ways in which these two types of organisms meet their basic needs
specific_expectations.text_html: describe various unicellular and multicellular organisms, and compare ways in which these two types of organisms meet their basic needs

specific_expectations.text: describe the organization of cells into tissues, organs, and systems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the organization of cells into tissues, organs, and systems

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: analyse uses of various technologies that rely on the properties of fluids, and assess the impact of these technologies on society and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: analyse uses of various technologies that rely on the properties of fluids, and assess the impact of these technologies on society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess the environmental, social, and economic impacts of various innovations and technologies that are based on the properties of fluids
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the environmental, social, and economic impacts of various innovations and technologies that are based on the properties of fluids

specific_expectations.text: assess the environmental and social impacts of fluid spills, including impacts on First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, and including the cost and technical challenges related to cleanup and remediation efforts
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the environmental and social impacts of fluid spills, including impacts on First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, and including the cost and technical challenges related to cleanup and remediation efforts

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of basic fluid mechanics, including the properties and uses of fluids
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of basic fluid mechanics, including the properties and uses of fluids

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the factors that affect viscosity, and compare the viscosity of various fluids, including volumetric flow rate
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the factors that affect viscosity, and compare the viscosity of various fluids, including volumetric flow rate

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between mass, volume, and density
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between mass, volume, and density

specific_expectations.text: explain the difference between solids, liquids, and gases in terms of their density, using the particle theory of matter
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the difference between solids, liquids, and gases in terms of their density, using the particle theory of matter

specific_expectations.text: explain the difference between liquids and gases in terms of their compressibility and how their compressibility affects their technological applications
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the difference between liquids and gases in terms of their compressibility and how their compressibility affects their technological applications

specific_expectations.text: determine the buoyancy of an object, given its density, in a variety of fluids
specific_expectations.text_html: determine the buoyancy of an object, given its density, in a variety of fluids

specific_expectations.text: explain in qualitative terms the relationship between pressure, volume, and temperature when a liquid or a gas is compressed or heated
specific_expectations.text_html: explain in qualitative terms the relationship between pressure, volume, and temperature when a liquid or a gas is compressed or heated

specific_expectations.text: describe how forces are transferred in all directions in fluids, including using Pascal’s law to quantify the transfer of forces in fluids
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how forces are transferred in all directions in fluids, including using Pascal’s law to quantify the transfer of forces in fluids

specific_expectations.text: describe factors that affect the flow of fluids
specific_expectations.text_html: describe factors that affect the flow of fluids

specific_expectations.text: describe the differences between pneumatic and hydraulic systems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the differences between pneumatic and hydraulic systems

specific_expectations.text: compare how fluids are used and how their flow is regulated in living organisms and in mechanical devices or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: compare how fluids are used and how their flow is regulated in living organisms and in mechanical devices or systems

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the social and environmental impacts of various systems, and evaluate improvements to the systems or alternative ways of meeting the same needs
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the social and environmental impacts of various systems, and evaluate improvements to the systems or alternative ways of meeting the same needs

specific_expectations.text: assess the social, economic, and environmental impacts of automating systems
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the social, economic, and environmental impacts of automating systems

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact on individuals, society, and the environment of alternative ways of meeting needs that are currently met by existing systems, taking different points of view into consideration
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact on individuals, society, and the environment of alternative ways of meeting needs that are currently met by existing systems, taking different points of view into consideration

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of different types of systems and the factors that contribute to their safe and efficient operation
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of different types of systems and the factors that contribute to their safe and efficient operation

specific_expectations.text: identify various types of systems
specific_expectations.text_html: identify various types of systems

specific_expectations.text: describe the purpose, inputs, and outputs of various systems, including systems related to food processing
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the purpose, inputs, and outputs of various systems, including systems related to food processing

specific_expectations.text: identify the various processes and components of a system that allow it to perform its function efficiently and safely
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the various processes and components of a system that allow it to perform its function efficiently and safely

specific_expectations.text: use the scientific terms displacement, force, work, energy, and efficiency to describe everyday experiences
specific_expectations.text_html: use the scientific terms displacement, force, work, energy, and efficiency to describe everyday experiences

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the relationships between work, force, and displacement in simple systems
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the relationships between work, force, and displacement in simple systems

specific_expectations.text: explain the relationship between input and output forces and determine the mechanical advantage of various mechanical systems, including simple machines
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the relationship between input and output forces and determine the mechanical advantage of various mechanical systems, including simple machines

specific_expectations.text: identify ways in which energy can dissipate from mechanical systems, and describe technological innovations that make these systems more efficient
specific_expectations.text_html: identify ways in which energy can dissipate from mechanical systems, and describe technological innovations that make these systems more efficient

specific_expectations.text: explain how providing information and support to consumers helps to ensure that the systems they use run safely and efficiently
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how providing information and support to consumers helps to ensure that the systems they use run safely and efficiently

specific_expectations.text: describe technological innovations involving mechanical systems that have increased productivity in various industries

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 8, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the sustainability of water resources
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of human activities and technologies on the sustainability of water resources

specific_expectations.text: assess the social and environmental impact of the scarcity of fresh water, and propose a plan of action to help address fresh water sustainability issues
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the social and environmental impact of the scarcity of fresh water, and propose a plan of action to help address fresh water sustainability issues

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit knowledges and values about water, connections to water, and ways of managing water resources sustainably
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit knowledges and values about water, connections to water, and ways of managing water resources sustainably

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact of scientific discoveries and technological innovations on local and global water systems
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of scientific discoveries and technological innovations on local and global water systems

overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the characteristics of Earth’s water systems and of factors that affect these systems

specific_expectations.text_html: explain changes in atmospheric conditions caused by the presence of bodies of water
